latest_cos_commentary.headline: DoorDash-owned guest relationship platform has a distribution advantage in reservations and commerce.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: DoorDash-owned guest relationship platform has a distribution advantage in reservations and commerce.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: DoorDash completed the SevenRooms acquisition in June 2025; its announcement describes CRM, reservations, marketing and more than 13,000 hospitality venues globally. Second check: DoorDash said new SevenRooms venue signings grew more than 100% year over year in Q2 2026.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Check DoorDash and SevenRooms contract scope, guest-data access and integration rights at each shared prospect.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Venue count includes hotel food and beverage, nightlife and entertainment; this older announcement needs current footprint confirmation. Growth rate for newly signed venues is not revenue, installed base, or standalone profit.
